Name: Clothing Buffs and Price Adjustments
Author: Adalghizar
Description:
Have you ever wanted to play with a tailoring-focused playthrough that was actually profitable? Have you ever wanted to expand your wardrobe, but didn't have the gameplay incentive to do so?  If so, this mod may be just for you! 

A comprehensive list of all the buffs and price changes for my mods can be found here:

[url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1F5zWc1NNwPpJldpeQMjdtT-CGBRLOIirHySMzy59DdM/edit?usp=sharing][center][color=#00ff00][size=6][b]My Spreadsheet[/b][/size][/color][/center][/url]
[b][color=#f4f4f4][size=3]Features:[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]You can now sell clothing to Sandy and the Traveling Cart! 
[*]Shirts and Bottoms prices have been completely revamped, so that it is profitable to actually craft them! They automatically adjust for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13426]Theoddon's SDV Balance Overhaul Mod[/url]﻿.
[*]An option to have Sheep available for the Basic Barn, allowing you to craft Cloth as soon as you get that Loom! Enabled by default in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url]﻿ menu. It is best not to toggle off once you have purchased your sheep, so decide early!
[*]Buffs for Shirts, Bottoms, and Hats!  Specific Outfits give additional Buffs as well, rewarding coordinating.  These categories can be disabled as you desire in the GMCM menu. Clothing descriptions have been edited, so you can now see what goes with what, and the effects without wearing it first. If Buffs are enabled then disabled, enhanced descriptions will remain, but the buffs will be disabled (the icons will disappear). Restart game to revert the descriptions.
[*]Enable/Disable constant glows from Monster Musk and Oil of Garlic Buffs. If the constant glowing that comes with the Outfit Buffs bothers you as much as it does me, you can individually choose to globally disable them in the GMCM menu. Disabled by default.
[*]Enable/Disable dyeable shirts for Regal Mantle, Officer Uniform, Leafy Top. Disabled by default.
[/list][b][size=3]
Installation:[/size][/b]
Unzip into the Mods folder. A config file will be generated upon initial startup.

[b][color=#00ff00][size=3]Compatibility:[/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*]The additional dyeable shirts may get overwritten by other mods that change the shirt graphics. The custom tailored colors will look different if that happens. 
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿: If you love a buff combo and love a Fashion Sense look, they do not conflict.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27626]Outfit Sets for 1.6[/url]﻿: The buffs will automatically change upon switching to a new outfit. A good way to coordinate with Fashion Sense Mods, especially [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21226]Farmer 2.0 ESWF[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18384]Fashion Sense Outfits[/url]﻿. Outfit Sets are save-specific.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27345]Skillful Clothes Revamp[/url]﻿: These have separate frameworks, so their effects will stack. However, this will make you incredibly OP.  If you want to use both mods together, I would recommend decreasing the effects of Skillful Clothes and/or disabling some of the Buff categories. Mods like the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25766]Change Combat Difficulty Mod [/url]﻿ can help you tailor your gameplay experience to your liking.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/24813]Forge[/url]﻿: Most items created through this mod have different internal names, so they will not be affected by this mod. For example, Breastplates crafted using the Forge mod will have different graphics, stats, buffs, and prices. The Iridium Breastplate crafted with Forge will not trigger the Outfit Buff. Crafted Shoes and Boots WILL work with this mod since they have the same internal name.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27343]Market Town[/url]﻿: Market Town uses its own internal randomized pricing system for selling clothing, so those will override this mod's. Luckily, they will generate a little more profit than selling to Sandy or the Traveling Cart, so it's a solid end-game strategy. There are exceptions, in which selling to Sandy or the Traveling Cart is always more profitable:
